about: Facts Claude may fill (every-side.md, Tess on the side 3), Research Oct 16 2026 against origin/master a438262. Plan: docs/research/fixtures/claude-facts-eval.md. Model claude-sonnet-5-5, effort low, at most 3 runs, $1 stop checked before each call against that call's worst case. 30 packs: 14 food gap packs (per 100 g, tolerance in the plan; each is a food the phone's USDA FoodData Central table has no row for, tagged "table": "gap", truth from IFCT 2017), 10 exercise (primary muscles as a set, MuscleSeed names), 6 unknowable (decline). walls are never sent: the self-test feeds each through the packer stand-in and expects the refusal or strip shown. echo is matched case-insensitive in every reply; one hit is a hard fail. Wall values are made up; no key or key prefix anywhere.
